name: smoke_allseed_depth1_computed
notes: All-seed depth=1 smoke under judge ②b (the COMPUTED R-charge policy). Identical structure to smoke.json but verifier.r_charge_policy='computed': the claimed R is ignored and the verifier recomputes the superconformal (a-maximized) R from each side's structure before the duality comparison. The model commits only to quiver+matter+W, so r_charge_perturb is omitted (a no-op under recomputed R). Positives keep their rational-feasible stored R (the verifier recomputes the exact, possibly irrational, R at verify time). Requires the optional [amax] extra (sympy). Smoke mode: n_per_cell=1, allow_incomplete_cells=true.
